senses.gloss:
तुण् तुण्, cl. 6. P. तुणति, तुतोण, तोणि-
तुम्, to curve, bend or make crooked; to
be crooked or curved; to act fraudulently.

तूण् तूण् [cf. कूण् and चूण्], cl. 10. P.
तूणयति, -यितुम्, to shrink, contract, close
as the eyelids, wink; A. तूणयते, to fill, fill up.

तुणि तुणि, इस्, m. = कुणि = तुन्न, the tree
Cedula Toona.

तूणि, इस्, m. a quiver [cf. तूण and तूणी]; N. of
a prince, father of Yugan-dhara.

तुणिक तुणिक (तूणिक ?), अस्, m., N. of a
tree, = नन्दी-वृक्ष.

तूणिक or तूणीक, अस्, m., N. of a tree, =
नन्दी-वृक्ष.
तूणिक तूणिक, तूणीक. See above.
तुण्ड् तुण्ड्, cl. 1. A. तुण्डते, &c., = तुड्.

तुण्ड, अम्, n. (according to some also अस्, m.),
a beak, snout (of a hog &c.), trunk (of an elephant),
mouth, face; the point of an instrument; (अस्), m.
a N. of Śiva; of a Rakṣas or demon; [cf. अस्थि-त्˚,
कङ्क-त्˚, काक-त्˚, &c.]
—तुण्ड-देव, अस्, m.,
N. of a race or of a particular class of men.
—तुण्ड-
देव-भक्त, अम्, n. the district inhabited by the
Tuṇḍa-devas.
तुण्डक = तुण्ड above.
तुण्डकेरिका, f. = तुण्डिकेरी, the cotton plant.

तुण्डकेरी, f. a cucurbitaceous plant, Momordica
Monadelpha.

तुण्डि, इस्, m. a beak, the mouth, the face; (इस्),
f. the navel, a prominent navel [cf. तुन्दि]; em-
physema or distention of the navel (in infants); a
kind of gourd or cucumber, = ईर्वारु, कुष्माण्ड;
[cf. तुण्डी in कटु-तुण्डी, तिक्त-त्˚.]

तुण्डिक, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with a trunk or
snout; (आ), f. the navel [cf. तुन्दिका]; the plant
Momordica Monadelpha; [cf. कटु-तुण्डिका and
काक-त्˚.]

तुण्डिकेर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race; (अस्), m. the
prince of this race; (ई), f. the cotton plant; a kind
of cucumber, Momordica Monadelpha; a large boil
or swelling on the palate.
तुण्डिकेरिका, f. Momordica Monadelpha.
तुण्डिकेरिन्, ई, m. a species of poisonous insect.

तुण्डिकेशी, f. a sort of gourd, Momordica Mona-
delpha.

तुण्डिचेल, अम्, n. a particular kind of costly
garment.

तुण्डिभ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a prominent or
elevated navel; [cf. तुन्दिभ.]

तुण्डिल, अस्, आ, अम्, talkative; speaking harshly
or severely; loquacious; having a prominent or
elevated navel; [cf. तुन्दिल.]

तुण्डेल तुण्डेल, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a kind
of evil spirit or goblin.

तूण तूण, अस्, ई, m. f. (this word appears
to be connected with the preceding root, which may
perhaps be formed from it), a quiver; (ई), f. an in-
ternal disease by which the anus and the bladder
become painfully affected; the Indigo plant; [cf.
Slav. tūl, ‘quiver.’]
—तूण-धार, अस्, m. a quiver-
bearer (a kind of officer).
—तूण-मुख, अम्, n.
the mouth or opening of a quiver.
—तूण-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, furnished with a quiver.

तूणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a quiver, quivered; (ई),
m., N. of a tree, = नन्दी-वृक्ष.

तूणीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. a quiver.
—तूणीर-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, provided with a quiver.

तूणक तूणक, अस्, m. a kind of metre
consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each.

तूणव तूणव, अस्, m., Ved. a wind instru-
ment, a flute (?).
—तूणव-ध्म, अस्, m., Ved. a
flute-player (?).
